briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Colossus push AGI timelines forward amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as competition intensifies. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows in US and EU. Multi-agent systems emerge as next battleground.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind releases Gemini 3 and Meta open-sources Llama 4. xAI deploys Colossus cluster for Grok-3 training.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly. Microsoft and Oracle announce new 200MW AI data centers in Texas. TSMC 2nm process yields improve for custom ASICs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the capability gap with closed labs by end of 2027?
